categories.title: Boutique
categories.info: Boutiques are stores that specialize entirely in wardrobe clothing items. Once you've purchased everything in their stock, the map icon will be marked with a tick.

categories.title: Catapult Seal
categories.info:
Need a boost? Use the powerful bouncing tails of seal Whimborn to launch Nikki up, up, and away!

Speak to the NPC nearby to feed the seal. When its tail glows, the seal is ready to launch Nikki.

categories.title: General Store
categories.info: General Stores sell any non-clothing item, usually within a specific theme of crafting materials. Unlike Boutiques, their map icons aren't marked with a tick even after you buy everything.

categories.title: Gliding Station
categories.info: After unlocking the Floral Memory Outfit, Nikki can use Skypass routes to glide across great distances.
categories.template: _??'s Gliding Station. After the station manager activates the Stoneheart, a Skypass from ?? to ?? can be opened. Have fun gliding!_

categories.title: House
categories.info: Houses are non-hostile buildings that you can enter and interact with NPCs inside.

categories.title: Sky Monarch
categories.info: Groom the Sky Monarch when it lands here at its nest to be able ride on its back. This will often allow you to reach very high Whimstars.

categories.title: Stray Hatty
categories.info: Stray Hatty has been stranded in Florawish with only their Master's Whim energy to spare. Trade increasing amounts of Blings in exchange for Stray Hatty's Whimstars.

categories.title: Surprise-O-Matic
categories.info: Spend Blings at this clothing vending machine for a chance at some rare wardrobe pieces!
categories.template: _A clothing vending machine created by the Whale Consortium. Rumble, rumble... the surprise ball is rolling, and your heart is racing!_

categories.title: Warp Spire
categories.info: Activate Warp Spires to unlock fast travel and respawn points across Miraland. You can fast travel by selecting a spire from the map screen. Each one discovered gives 20x Diamonds.

categories.title: Box Game
categories.info:
Test Nikki's skills with Wishfield's regional box games popular among local townspeople. After completing a collection, speak to [Ciceto](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421553) in Florawish for additional rewards.

**Rewards:**
- Diamond x10
- Bling x12K

categories.title: Curio Domain
categories.info: Enter Curio gateways to complete skill challenges and earn Whimstars.

categories.title: Expedition Photo
categories.info:
After unlocking the camera, Nikki can embark on Expedition Quests. Like other photo quests, these require you to take photos of specific subjects or locations. Make sure to upload photos to the Expedition Journal for them to count!

**Reward:** Upgrade Pack x3

categories.title: Mini Game
categories.info: Test your skills with obstacle courses throughout Miraland! Each mini-game attempt costs 100 Blings. Your first Clear awards 10 Diamonds, and your first Perfect Clear awards 30 more Diamonds.

categories.title: Power Box
categories.info:
Explore Miraland at night to see broken, sparking streetlamps that can be repaired with an Electrician ability outfit.

**Rewards:**
- 30 x Diamonds
- 10,000 Blings

categories.title: Styling Challenge
categories.info: Styling Challenges are essentially the "boss battles" of fashion in Miraland. Rise through the faction ranks until Nikki reaches can challenge the regional Sovereign.

categories.title: Dew of Inspiration
categories.info: Dews can be given to [Kilo the Candenceborn](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419501) in Florawish and [Ian the Cadenceborn](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507251) in Itzaland in exchange for resources, Mira EXP, exclusive Sketches and music Records. To collect these, hit them with a purification attack.

categories.title: Lore Item
categories.info: Books and other documents that expand on the lore of Infinity Nikki. These are logged in the Pearpal's Lore section of the Compendium.

categories.title: Record
categories.info: Records can be played on Gramophones at Nikki's House to play pieces of the game's soundtrack instead of the normal Nikki's House music.

categories.title: Whimstar
categories.info: Whimstars are the major collectible in Wishfield, and are used to purchase unlocked nodes in the Hearts of Infinity.

categories.title: Bling Esseling
categories.info: An Esseling that A unique Esseling that erupts into 3K Blings after being defeated, and respawns daily at designated locations. Florawish's Greedy Pouches will try to run away, while Itzaland's Flit-Flits will stand and fight.

categories.title: Chest (Advanced)
categories.info:
Advanced Chests are sparkling pink-and-white boxes found throughout Miraland. In addition to normal chest rewards, they sometimes contain rare items like Outfit Sketches and Fragrances.

**Rewards:**
- Diamond x 30
- Bling x 1,000
- Mira EXP x 40
- Thread of Purity x 20

categories.title: Chest (Intermediate)
categories.info:
**Rewards:**
- Mira EXP x20
- Diamond x10
- Thread of Purity x10
- Blings x500

categories.title: Chest (Primary)
categories.info:
**Rewards:**
- Diamond x 5
- Bling x 300
- Mira EXP x 10

categories.title: Momo Chest
categories.info:
**Rewards:**
- Prime BBQ x1
- Diamond x 5
- Bling x 300
- Mira EXP x 10

categories.title: Exclusive Quest
categories.info: Exclusive Quests are the longest kind of side quests, often involving a lengthy quest chain. Story quests tied to new updates will use Exclusive Quests in lieu of Main Quests.

categories.title: Main Quest
categories.info: Main Quests comprise the main story of Infinity Nikki regarding the Miracle Outfits and coma incidents. They unlock new areas, features and Ability Outfits.

categories.title: Random Quest
categories.info: Random Quests are short side quests that can usually be completed in the area where you started them.

categories.title: World Quest
categories.info: World Quests are side quests that, as the name implies, tend to send Nikki all across the map the quest is given in.

categories.title: Placeholder 5
categories.info: A weekly Starlit Pursuit. Follow the Blings to collect Starlit Crystals that you can use to purchase items in the Starlit Shop.
categories.template: _A strange phenomenon has appeared ?? the ??. You might be able to collect starlight spilling out of the Sea of Stars there._

categories.title: Recycling
categories.info: Allows you to trade in duplicate Resonance clothing items in exchange for Glow Up Bubbles. **Make sure you no longer need the items**; 4 and 5-Star Outfits require a full duplicate outfit to unlock an alternate palette via Outfit Evolution.
categories.template: _The mysterious recycling merchant has appeared. Check out what precious materials she has in stock this time!_
